Montag & Caldwell LLC Has Raised Its Holding in Edwards Lifesciences Corp (EW) by $5.13 Million as Share Value Declined
June 24, 2018 - By Adrian Erickson
Montag & Caldwell Llc increased its stake in Edwards Lifesciences Corp (EW) by 4.11% based on its latest 2018Q1 regulatory filing with the SEC. Montag & Caldwell Llc bought 36,873 shares as the company’s stock declined 0.56% with the market. The institutional investor held 934,768 shares of the industrial specialties company at the end of 2018Q1, valued at $130.42M, up from 897,895 at the end of the previous reported quarter. Montag & Caldwell Llc who had been investing in Edwards Lifesciences Corp for a number of months, seems to be bullish on the $32.22B market cap company. The stock increased 0.45% or $0.69 during the last trading session, reaching $152.87. About 1.11 million shares traded. Edwards Lifesciences Corporation (NYSE:EW) has risen 19.08% since June 24, 2017 and is uptrending. It has outperformed by 6.51% the S&P500.
Montag & Caldwell Llc, which manages about $14.22B and $2.75 billion US Long portfolio, decreased its stake in Unitedhealth Group Inc (NYSE:UNH) by 73,428 shares to 608,780 shares, valued at $130.28M in 2018Q1, according to the filing. It also reduced its holding in Apple Inc (NASDAQ:AAPL) by 362,648 shares in the quarter, leaving it with 462,138 shares, and cut its stake in Alphabet Inc Cl A.
